company.name: JetClass
company.shortDescription: JetClass's mission is to democratize private jet travel, making it more accessible and efficient by leveraging proprietary AI technology.
company.description:
JetClass is at the forefront of transforming the private aviation industry by making the luxury and convenience of private jet travel accessible to a broader audience. Utilizing cutting-edge, proprietary AI technology, JetClass offers a range of innovative air mobility services that bridge the gap between commercial and private aviation.

Imagine a private jet experience that is as convenient and accessible as commercial aviation. The “Jet Class” is the convergence of private and commercial aviation, making private jets available to a wider range of customers at a more affordable price. By democratizing the industry, we are revolutionizing the way people travel. Join us in our mission to change the way the world flies.

JetClass is revolutionizing Air Mobility with unique business models and proprietary AI technology. We leverage advanced algorithms, data analytics, and machine learning to streamline and bring efficiency, transparency, and convenience to the private jet travel industry.

Our innovative approach to private aviation, combined with an experienced management team and strong industry partnerships, positions us for rapid growth and success in the years to come.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 51 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 32 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
